what_we_know: Footwear (loafers, boots, sneakers) and clothing (knitwear, shirts and polos, tees, jackets, blazers, bottoms, socks, hats) plus accessories. Describes itself as inspired by the spirit and heritage of New England. Women have their own section; the other categories are not labeled by gender on the home page. Nav: Shop (All Footwear, All Clothing, Explore, Women), Fall Focus, The Inkerman Standard, The Journal, Store Locations. Home page shows prices (footwear about 365 to 465, knitwear about 145 to 285) with Pre-Order buttons. Home page states no founding year or place and no place of manufacture.
